_comment: The register's default order is the state ladder: pending, then unfiled, then unapproved, then uncleared, then cleared, and reconciled last — finished work sinks. The server pages rows in this order (`REGISTER_LADDER` in backend/src/igab/repositories/txn_filters.py, run by backend/tests/unit/test_register_order.py) and the client re-sorts the pages it has loaded the same way (frontend/src/components/transactions/TransactionTable/registerOrder.ts, run by registerOrder.test.ts). The two must agree or a row changes place as you scroll. Rank is an index into the ladder, so the numbers here are the ladder itself.

cases.note: a pending row is provisional and sits above everything
pending wins over both work states — it has its own section
unfiled work outranks every cleared state
a reconciled row that is still unfiled does NOT sink — the sink is for finished work, and this is not finished
filed but unapproved: the row is categorized, so it is not in the review section, but it still wants a look
unapproved beats reconciled — an import can land both on one row, and the unread half is what matters
the ordinary typed row, waiting for the bank
the bank has it; nothing left to do until reconciling
the whole point: settled rows fall below everything else
